description: This file is a shell script that contains a comprehensive set of tests for Git's 'describe' command. The tests cover various scenarios such as describing commits, tags, blobs, handling broken submodules, dirty worktrees, non-monotonic timestamps, and more. It also includes setup routines for repositories and specific test cases to verify the correctness and robustness of the 'git describe' functionality.

methods.name: check_describe
methods.description: A function that runs 'git describe' with specified options and compares the output with expected results, handling various success and failure scenarios.
